finalText:
Build's clean now, exit 0, 0 errors.

Found two real bugs from the bump, not noise:

`src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. Fixed to read `retryCount`.

`src/net/retryPolicy.js` threw when `backoffEnabled` was `undefined`. New config loader leaves unset flags undefined instead of `false`. Now treats `undefined` as disabled.

The rest was deprecation noise from the bumped packages, harmless.
